submit_job: submit a SLURM job using submitit with a command, job name, and resource parameters
get_logs: retrieve stdout and stderr logs from a submitted SLURM job as lists of strings
JobObserver_observe: observe a submitit job status and execute a callback when the job finishes
JobObserver_wait: wait asynchronously for all observed SLURM jobs and their callbacks to complete
JobResult: create a dataclass aggregating job ID, metadata, status, stdout, and stderr for a finished job
